title: Automatic service start on package installation
description: Debian/Ubuntu automatically starts daemons upon apt-get install.
recommendation: If configuration is required before starting, prepare config files in advance or handle the initial failed start.
do_not_do: Do not assume installed services are stopped.

title: PEP 668 externally-managed Python environment
description: Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 23.04+ disable direct pip install into system Python.
recommendation: Use python3 -m venv <dir> or apt-get install python3-<pkg>.
do_not_do: Do not use --break-system-packages unless strictly isolated in a container.

title: Deb822 structured format in Ubuntu 24.04+
description: Ubuntu 24.04 stores repository entries in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources rather than classic one-line format.
recommendation: Check for .sources files when inspecting or managing repositories.
do_not_do: Do not append classic one-line deb entries directly into /etc/apt/sources.list on 24.04+ without checking.
